title: policy_deployment_contract
description: Schema for a deployable policy's contract.yaml (claude-docs/08-learning.md 'Deployment contract'). additionalProperties is false at every level so a manifest with a missing OR extra field fails validation -- there is no lenient/partial contract.

dtype.description: The dtype the policy was TRAINED against for this field. Compared against the live topic's actual dtype at deploy time -- a mismatch is a hard refusal (claude-docs/12-testing.md L1 'wrong dtype').

units.description: SI unit string (CLAUDE.md invariant 4), e.g. 'm/s', 'rad', 'dimensionless'. Compared verbatim against the live field's units at deploy time (claude-docs/12-testing.md L1 'wrong units string').

contract_version.description: Semver of the CONTRACT FORMAT (not the policy). The loader refuses on a major-version mismatch against the loader's own supported major (claude-docs/08-learning.md).

filename.description: Filename of the policy weights artifact, relative to the contract directory (e.g. 'policy.pt').

checksum_sha256.description: sha256 hex digest of the policy artifact's raw bytes, computed at training/export time. Verified byte-for-byte at load_contract() time -- a mismatch is a hard refusal, never a warning.

fields.description: Low-dimensional observation fields IN THE EXACT ORDER the policy was trained on (claude-docs/08-learning.md 'Boring choices, committed': velocity, yaw rate, slip proxy, raceline-relative pose, ...). Order is part of the contract: a live topic set with the same fields in a different order is a hard refusal.

beam_count.description: Number of LiDAR beams AFTER downsampling, as seen by the policy.

fov_rad.description: Total LiDAR field of view the beams span.

downsample_factor.description: Integer downsampling factor applied to the raw /scan beam count to reach beam_count.

normalization.description: Observation normalization statistics from training time, one entry per flattened observation element (the low-dimensional fields, in order, followed by the downsampled LiDAR beams).

fields.description: Residual action bounds the policy was trained to output, IN ORDER (e.g. steering_residual_rad, speed_residual_mps).

scaling.description: How a raw network output in [-1, 1] is mapped onto [low, high] for each action field. Only 'linear' is supported; anything else is out of scope until asked (CLAUDE.md).

residual_limits.description: Envelope residual fractions (claude-docs/05-safety.md, training/envelope/) the policy was TRAINED against. These are recorded for provenance/audit; the live envelope/ library is still the one enforcing them at deploy time (claude-docs/02-repo-layout.md: 'Never fork its logic').

actuator_assumptions.description: Actuator dynamics the policy was trained against (claude-docs/08-learning.md 'Actuator assumptions trained against: rate limits, delays').

vehicle_params.description: Which config/vehicle_params.yaml (claude-docs/06-vehicle-params.md) version and sysid session this policy was trained against.

training.description: Reproducibility provenance (claude-docs/10-conventions.md: 'Experiments are reproducible from: config file + git SHA + seed + vehicle_params version').
